# Team Meeting Agenda for 2026-03-18 2:00–3:00 PM ET

A focused 60-minute meeting for 6 participants to clear blockers, assign owners, and lock next steps. The structure below keeps discussion tight and leaves the meeting with clear decisions.

## 60-Minute Time-Boxed Agenda

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

- 2:00–2:05 — Opening and goal check
  - Confirm meeting outcome: blockers, owners, next steps
  - Review agenda and time limits
- 2:05–2:20 — Project blocker review
  - Each participant shares the top blocker
  - Capture impact, urgency, and any dependencies
- 2:20–2:40 — Ownership and decision making
  - Assign a single owner per blocker
  - Decide what can be resolved now vs. escalated
- 2:40–2:55 — Next steps and deadlines
  - Confirm actions, due dates, and success criteria
  - Identify any follow-up meetings or async updates
- 2:55–3:00 — Wrap-up
  - Read back decisions and action items
  - Confirm who sends the recap

## Concise Agenda Structure

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/list-check.svg

- **Meeting objective:** Resolve blockers and leave with named owners
- **Attendees:** 6 participants
- **Facilitator:** You
- **Note taker:** One participant assigned at the start
- **Decision rule:** If a blocker cannot be resolved in the meeting, assign an owner and a due date for follow-up
- **Output:** Decision log, action list, and recap email

## Follow-Up Email Template

Subject: Meeting Recap — Blockers, Owners, and Next Steps

Hi team,

Thanks for joining today’s meeting. We reviewed the current project blockers, assigned owners, and agreed on the next steps.

**Decisions made**
- [Decision 1]
- [Decision 2]
- [Decision 3]

**Action items**
- [Owner] — [Action] — Due: [Date]
- [Owner] — [Action] — Due: [Date]
- [Owner] — [Action] — Due: [Date]

**Open items**
- [Blocked item] — Owner: [Name] — Follow-up by: [Date]
- [Blocked item] — Owner: [Name] — Follow-up by: [Date]

Please reply if I missed anything or if any action item needs correction.

Thanks,
[Your Name]

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Copy agenda] https://calendar.google.com/
Action: [Button: Draft recap] https://mail.google.com/

- Calendar reference: https://calendar.google.com/
- Email draft reference: https://mail.google.com/
